scene osakonewhair1
What I can do, though, is finally talk to Osako about her cool new haircut.
lines.zh: 不过,我能做的,是终于和 Osako 谈谈她那酷炫的新发型。

lines.en: : And now it’s time for the main event.
lines.zh: : 现在,是主赛事时间。

lines.en: : You leaving and me preparing for my next class?
lines.zh: : 你走人,我准备下一节课?

lines.en: : You don’t have another class. It’s all in your head.
lines.zh: : 你没有下一节课。那是你脑补的。

lines.en: : There are a lot of things in my head right now, but I can assure you that my schedule is not one of-
lines.zh: : 我脑子里现在装着很多东西,但我向你保证,日程表不在其——

lines.en: scene osakonewhair2
: Wha-
: I’m sorry. I’ve been just overcome by an immense need to ruffle your hair up.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。一股巨大的冲动淹没了我——我必须把你的头发揉乱。

lines.en: : Right. But, just to remind you, I probably could have been an Olympian if I applied myself. So you invading my personal space is-
lines.zh: : 是吗。不过提醒你一句,我要是肯用功,大概能进奥运会。所以你入侵我的私人空间——

lines.en: : Your hair is so soft now.
lines.zh: : 你的头发现在好软。

lines.en: scene osakonewhair3
: What do you mean “now?!” I’ve never let you touch me before! And I’m not about to start just because of your “immense needs!”
lines.zh: : 「现在」是什么意思?!我以前从没让你碰过我!我也不会因为你的「巨大冲动」就破例开始!

lines.en: scene osakonewhair4
: Sorry. I’ve gotten it out of my system. I’m just not used to you looking so cute.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。冲动已经发泄掉了。只是不习惯你看起来这么可爱。

lines.en: : Yeah, well...it was just time for a change. But not the kind of change that makes it okay for you to lay your gross fingers all over me.
lines.zh: : 是啊,这个嘛……只是到了该变一变的时候。但可不是那种让你可以把你恶心手指到处乱放的改变。

lines.en: : They’re not gross.
lines.zh: : 它们不恶心。

lines.en: : How many girls have they been inside now?
lines.zh: : 它们现在已经进过多少个女孩了?

lines.en: : Not enough. Also, you like girls.
lines.zh: : 还不够多。另外,你喜欢的是女孩。

lines.en: : Yeah, but the ones I like are a little older. So if you do that again, I’m just going to break your entire arm off.
lines.zh: : 是,但我喜欢的那些稍微年长一点。所以你要是再来一次,我就把你整条胳膊掰下来。

lines.en: : Fair enough. But I would now like to press you about why you felt the need for a “change” as it coincides with a thing that’s been on my mind a lot lately.
lines.zh: : 公平。不过现在,我想追问一下你为什么觉得需要「变一变」——因为它和我最近惦记的一件事正好撞上了。

lines.en: : Don’t you have better things to do with your time than worrying about a pair of local lesbians?
lines.zh: : 你的时间就没有更好的去处吗,非要操心本地的一对蕾丝边?

lines.en: : There’s saving the world, but that’s just really hard.
lines.zh: : 有啊,拯救世界。但那个真的太难。

lines.en: scene osakonewhair5
: You’re seriously still worried about us?
lines.zh: : 你真还在为我们担心?

lines.en: : Yes. And even more so now that you’ve changed your hairstyle. That’s a breakup move.
lines.zh: : 是。而且你换了发型之后更甚。那是分手动作。

lines.en: scene osakonewhair6
: It’s not always a breakup move, you know. Sometimes, a girl just...wants to change up her look.
lines.zh: : 那不总是分手动作,你知道吧。有时候,一个女孩就是……想换换造型。

lines.en: : Is that what’s happening this time?
lines.zh: : 这次是那种情况吗?

lines.en: scene osakonewhair7
: Kind of, yeah.
lines.zh: : 算是,吧。

lines.en: : So you two are still together?
lines.zh: : 所以你们俩还在一起?

lines.en: : Kind of, yeah.
lines.zh: : 算是,吧。

lines.en: : Being “kind of” together doesn’t really bode well for the future, Osako.
lines.zh: : 「算是」在一起,对未来可不是什么好兆头,Osako。

lines.en: scene osakonewhair8
: Yeah, you think I don’t fucking know that?
lines.zh: : 是啊,你以为我不知道吗,该死的?

lines.en: : Sometimes, it feels like the only reason we’re still together at all is because it would be too inconvenient to break up.
lines.zh: : 有时候,我感觉我们还在一起的唯一理由,就是分手实在太麻烦。

lines.en: : But dwelling on it any longer isn’t going to do me any good. So I figured- hey. What signifies a fresh start better than a...fresh hairstyle?
lines.zh: : 但再纠结下去对我没有任何好处。所以我寻思——嘿。还有什么比一个……全新发型,更能象征全新开始?

lines.en: : We could always have another foursome. That seemed to work pretty well at reigniting your chemistry last time.
lines.zh: : 我们随时可以再来一次四人行。上次那招在重燃你们俩的化学反应上,效果似乎相当不错。

lines.en: scene osakonewhair9
: Almost too well. But I’m going to throw myself into blissful ignorance and just assume that was a coincidence.
lines.zh: : 好得几乎过头。但我打算一头扎进幸福的无知里,就当那是个巧合。

lines.en: : So are you two just...on a break now or something?
lines.zh: : 所以你们俩现在只是……在冷静期还是什么?

lines.en: scene osakonewhair10
: No...it’s not like that.
lines.zh: : 不……不是那样。

lines.en: : We’re still together. We’re still living in the same house and sleeping in the same bed, but...there are some things that have to change if we’re going to get back to the way we were.
lines.zh: : 我们还在一起。还住在同一间屋子里,睡同一张床,但……要想回到过去的样子,有些事必须改变。

lines.en: : And, as you may have guessed, they’re mostly on my end. So I’m just trying to...focus on myself for now. Put myself in a better head-space.
lines.zh: : 而且,正如你大概已经猜到,需要改变的主要是我这边。所以我现在只是试着……把注意力放在自己身上。让自己进入一个更好的心理状态。

lines.en: : Why would I guess that you’re the problem when Wakana’s got the downer mindset of Edgar Allan Poe and the medicinal tendencies of Heath Ledger?
lines.zh: : 当 Wakana 心态消沉得像 Edgar Allan Poe、用药习惯像 Heath Ledger 的时候,我为什么会猜到问题出在你身上?

lines.en: : Because I’m the one with less self-confidence than a rabbit being chased by a fox.
lines.zh: : 因为那个自信心比被狐狸追赶的兔子还少的人,是我。

lines.en: : Wakana is many things, but I’m not sure a “fox” is one of them. At least not in the...animal sort of way.
lines.zh: : Wakana 是很多东西,但我不确定「狐狸」是不是其中之一。至少不是……动物意义上的。

lines.en: scene osakonewhair11
: Please refrain from subtly voicing your attraction to my girlfriend even if we’re in a bit of a tight spot right now.
lines.zh: : 请收起你对我女朋友吸引力的隐晦表达,哪怕我们眼下确实处境有点窘迫。

lines.en: : It’s not just Wakana. I’d also like to be in a tight spot with you if you know what I’m saying.
lines.zh: : 不只是 Wakana。我也想和你身处窘境,如果你懂我在说什么的话。

lines.en: scene osakonewhair12
: All I know is that I’m suddenly nauseous.
lines.zh: : 我只知道,我突然想吐了。

lines.en: scene osakonewhair13
: And also that...this has been in the works for a long time. You’ve known from the start that I’m pretty much always kind of...worried when it comes to my relationship with Wakana.
lines.zh: : 还有就是……这事酝酿已久。你从一开始就知道,一涉及我和 Wakana 的关系,我几乎总是有点……忧心忡忡。

lines.en: : And I guess that...has just finally weighed on her a little too much with some of the things I’ve been saying to her.
lines.zh: : 而我猜……我一直在对她说的那些话,终于压得她有点喘不过气了。

lines.en: scene osakonewhair14
: So I’ve started working on Osako 2.0 — the new, confident and cool model who will be able to give her partner tons of love and tons of orgasms.
lines.zh: : 所以我已开始研发 Osako 2.0——全新、自信又酷的机型,能为她的伴侣提供海量的爱,和海量的高潮。

lines.en: : I see.
lines.zh: : 我懂了。

lines.en: : So the time has finally come for the apprentice to teach his master. What you want to do with your hands is-
lines.zh: : 所以,学徒教师傅的时刻终于到了。你想对手做的事是——

lines.en: scene osakonewhair15
: I don’t need your help with sexual stuff, Akira! That comes down to...finding the right medication or...something.
lines.zh: : 性事方面我不需要你帮忙,Akira!那得靠……找到正确的药,或者……什么。

lines.en: : You don’t sound very confident about that, Osako.
lines.zh: : 这话听起来可不怎么自信,Osako。

lines.en: scene osakonewhair16
: I KNOW! ARE YOU NOT PAYING ATTENTION?! THAT’S LIKE THE ROOT CAUSE OF ALL OF MY PROBLEMS!
lines.zh: : 我知道!你没在听吗?!这就是我所有问题的根源!

lines.en: scene osakonewhair17
: Regaining my confidence is just one step on the way to a new me — one whose existence doesn’t entirely revolve around her partner.
lines.zh: : 找回自信只是通往新我的第一步——一个不再完全围绕伴侣运转的新我。

lines.en: : I’m going to live how I want to live, and Wakana is going to see that I’m not just...some robot who was put here to want to fuck her.
lines.zh: : 我要按我想要的方式活,而 Wakana 会看到,我不只是……一台被放到这个世界上、专门用来想上她的机器人。

lines.en: : And if I have to sideline love for a little while in order to do that, fine. She’s made it clear that she’s not going anywhere if I’m going to actively try and change. So that’s what this is.
lines.zh: : 如果为了做到这一点,我必须暂时把爱放到一边,那也行。她已经明确表示,只要我积极尝试改变,她就不会离开。所以,这就是我在做的事。

lines.en: : So I have her to thank for your cool, new haircut. Got it.
lines.zh: : 所以,你这酷炫的新发型,要谢的人是她。明白。

lines.en: : In a roundabout way, I guess so. But with new hair comes new...other stuff. And from this point on, the Osako Osaka you know is going to be better and more likable.
lines.zh: : 绕了个弯来说,大概是。但新发型伴随而来的是新的……别的东西。从今往后,你认识的这个 Osako Osaka,会变得更好、更讨喜。

lines.en: : Awesome. So what’s the next step now that you’ve cut your hair?
lines.zh: : 太棒了。那剪完头发,下一步是什么?

lines.en: scene osakonewhair18
: I have no fucking clue. All I do apart from letting Wakana put stuff inside me is work. I think I need to...find a hobby or something. What do you do for fun, Akira?
lines.zh: : 我他妈一无所知。除了让 Wakana 往我体内塞东西,我干的一切就是工作。我觉得我需要……找个爱好什么的。你平时都拿什么找乐子,Akira?

lines.en: : Besides Ayane and Imani and whoever else you subject to your gross man-hands.
lines.zh: : 除了 Ayane、Imani 和其他被你那双恶心的男人手祸害过的人。

lines.en: : Oh.
: Is there even anything else? Or is that literally all you do?
lines.zh: : 除此之外还有别的吗?还是说那就是你字面意义上的全部生活?

lines.en: : I mean...
lines.zh: : 这个嘛……

lines.en: : I guess there’s porn?
lines.zh: : 大概还有色情片?

lines.en: scene osakonewhair19
: Your hobby is porn?
lines.zh: : 你的爱好是色情片?

lines.en: : The heart wants what the heart wants, Osako.
lines.zh: : 心想要它想要的,Osako。

lines.en: : I think you’re confusing your heart with that weird, fleshy growth between your legs.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你是把你那颗心,和两腿之间那个怪异的肉质增生物搞混了。

lines.en: : Yeah...I do that a lot, actually.
lines.zh: : 是啊……其实我经常这么搞混。

lines.en: : So, do you have any idea of other things I can do that don’t involve making porn a major part of my life and free time?
lines.zh: : 那么,除了让色情片成为我人生和闲暇的主要部分之外,你还有什么别的主意吗?

lines.en: : No, not really. Let’s get really into porn together.
lines.zh: : 不,真没有。我们一起深度入坑色情片吧。

lines.en: : I think I’d rather just break up with Wakana at that point.
lines.zh: : 我觉得到了那一步,我宁可和 Wakana 分手。

lines.en: : You’ll cave. I know you.
lines.zh: : 你会屈服的。我了解你。

lines.en: : No, you know the old me. The new me doesn’t do stuff like that.
lines.zh: : 不,你了解的是旧我。新我不干那种事。

lines.en: : Yes she does.
lines.zh: : 她会的。

lines.en: : No she doesn’t.
lines.zh: : 她不会。

lines.en: : Yes she does.
lines.zh: : 她会的。

lines.en: : No...she doesn’t.
lines.zh: : 不……她不会。

lines.en: scene osakonewhair20
: I fucking hate you, Akira.
lines.zh: : 我他妈恨你,Akira。

lines.en: : Called it. This is great, though. Because now we can start a porn club.
lines.zh: : 猜中了。不过这也太棒了。因为现在我们可以开办色情片社团了。

lines.en: : I already have one! It’s called “Maki Miyamura’s MILF of the Month Membership — where mammaries become memories.”
lines.zh: : 我早就有了!它叫「Maki Miyamura 的本月 MILF 会员资格——让乳房变成回忆」。

lines.en: I meet up with Osako later that night after her shift at the maid cafe.
lines.zh: 当晚晚些时候,等 Osako 下她在女仆咖啡厅的班,我与她碰了头。

lines.en: And while she verbally disapproved of this affair becoming her next hobby (many times), it’s the only thread we have in common and the only way I can see myself helping.
lines.zh: 虽然她口头反对过让这事成为她的下一个爱好(很多次),但这是我们唯一共有的线头,也是我唯一想得出能帮上忙的方式。

lines.en: I just hope she doesn’t feel weird about watching porn next to a heterosexual male that she will never want to have sex with as a tried and true lesbian woman.
lines.zh: 我只是希望,对一个铁杆真格的蕾丝边女性来说,在一个她永远不想与之做爱的异性恋男人旁边看色情片,不会让她觉得怪。

lines.en: : You know, as a tried and true lesbian woman, I’ve gotta say — it feels kind of weird watching  porn next to a heterosexual male that I will never want to have sex with.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗,身为一个铁杆真格的蕾丝边女性,我必须说——在一个我永远不想与之做爱的异性恋男人旁边看色情片,感觉确实有点怪。

lines.en: : Yay! That sentence implies it’s possible you’ll want to have sex with me one day. And while many others might be disturbed by that, I actually find it rather flattering.
lines.zh: : 耶!这句话暗示了,说不定哪天你会想和我做爱。虽然很多人可能被这话吓到,我却觉得相当受用。

lines.en: : Be careful, Maki. Osako is “kind of” in a relationship right now and you don’t want to step on her toes.
lines.zh: : 小心点,Maki。Osako 现在正「算是」处于一段恋情中,你可不想踩到她的脚。

lines.en: scene osakonewhair21
: Kind of? Are you and Watabe-sensei still having trouble? Did the Official Dildo Saber not fix everything? Because it says on the box that it’s supposed to.
lines.zh: : 「算是」?你和 Watabe 老师还有麻烦?官方 Dildo Saber 没能解决一切吗?因为盒子上写着它本该解决的。

lines.en: : Oh, right. You already know each other because Osako is a freak.
lines.zh: : 哦,对。你们已经认识了,因为 Osako 是个怪胎。

lines.en: : Some jobs just require certain tools and not all of us have them built into our bodies. But no, we’re fine. Ish. That’s not why I’m here, though.
lines.zh: : 有些工作就是需要特定的工具,而我们并非人人身上都自带。不过,不,我们没事。大概。但我来这儿不是为了这个。

lines.en: : So you are going to join the MILF of the Month club?
lines.zh: : 所以你要加入本月 MILF 俱乐部了?

lines.en: : I...don’t think so. I’m not really a MILF girl.
lines.zh: : 我……不觉得。我不是那种 MILF 派。

lines.en: : Not yet you’re not. But only because the film we’re watching today hasn’t had a chance to convert you yet.
lines.zh: : 现在还「不是」。但那只是因为今天我们要看的这部影片,还没来得及改造你。

lines.en: scene osakonewhair22
: Behold! The star of September — Reiko Kobayakawa! At only 41 years of age, she’s already starred in hundreds of films!
lines.zh: : 请看!九月之星——Reiko Kobayakawa!年仅 41 岁,便已主演过数百部影片!

lines.en: : Born in Tokyo and coming in at 165cm, her three sizes are 35/24/35! Making her not just an excellent role model for young women everywhere, but wonderfully proportionate!
lines.zh: : 生于东京,身高 165cm,三围 35/24/35!这让她不仅是各地年轻女性的绝佳榜样,更是比例惊人的完美存在!

lines.en: : Did you...memorize all of that for the sake of your club? Or...
lines.zh: : 你……是为了社团背下了这些?还是……

lines.en: : No. I memorized it for the sake of my heart.
lines.zh: : 不。我是为了我的心背下的。

lines.en: scene osakonewhair23
: I see...
lines.zh: : 我懂了……

lines.en: I tear myself away from September’s MILF of the Month and watch Osako as she...watches her. Which is weird. I know. But seeing her in a context like this is...kind of interesting to me.
lines.zh: 我把自己从九月本月 MILF 身边撕开,转而观察 Osako——她正在……观察她。这很怪。我知道。但在这种情境下看到她,对我而言……有点有趣。

lines.en: Like, maybe the two of us really can become porn buddies? And-
lines.zh: 就是说,也许我们两个真的能成为色情片搭子?而且——

lines.zh: : 拜托,别在一个 MILF 正在你面前发出可闻声浪地被猛操的时候,直勾勾盯着我看。

lines.en: : I’m sorry. I was just thinking of how nice this is.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我只是在想,这一切多么美好。

lines.en: scene osakonewhair24
: Why?
lines.zh: : 为什么?

lines.en: : Well, it’s just that everyone else I know wants to sleep with me. But with you, I can kick back and relax and enjoy my hobbies without having to worry about that.
lines.zh: : 就是说,我认识的其他所有人都想和我上床。但和你在一起,我可以翘起脚、放轻松、享受我的爱好,不用操心那种事。

lines.en: : Surely it’s not everyone. Like, you’re not banging Maki, are you?
lines.zh: : 肯定不是所有人吧。比如,你没和 Maki 上床吧?

lines.en: scene osakonewhair25
if makisex == True:
: Not currently. We can. I’d just have to charge you the live performance fee. And also ask you to vacate the couch since the floor is kind of sticky in here.
lines.zh: : 目前没有。可以安排。我只需要向你收取现场表演费。另外还得请你把沙发让出来,因为这片地面有点黏。

lines.en: else:
: He would be if I had anything to do with it. But breaching parent-teacher norms with me seems to be out of the question at this point in time for our friend here.
lines.zh: : 由我牵线的话,他会的。但对我们这位朋友来说,眼下要和我逾越家校规范,似乎是想都不必想的事。

lines.en: : Oooookay. Then I guess maybe I might be the only person you can do this with. But that doesn’t mean I want to.
lines.zh: : 好————吧。那我猜,也许我可能是唯一能陪你干这个的人。但这不代表我想干。

lines.en: : But you’re here, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 可你还是来了,不是吗?

lines.en: : Yeah — but that’s only because I’m trying to find a new hobby, remember?
lines.zh: : 对——但那只是因为我在试着找新爱好,记得吗?

lines.en: scene osakonewhair24
: Chances are, I’ll be trying out a bunch of new stuff in the near future. And getting this one out of the way early will at least get you off my back for a little while.
lines.zh: : 很可能,不久的将来我会试一大堆新东西。而先把这一项解决掉,至少能让你消停一小会儿。

lines.en: : “Trying a bunch of new stuff” you say?
lines.zh: : 「试一大堆新东西」,你说?

lines.en: : Are you actually even attracted to me? Or are you just being non-stop flirty today because you know nothing’s going to come of it?
lines.zh: : 你到底真的被我吸引吗?还是说你今天之所以没完没了地调情,是因为你知道不会有什么结果?

lines.en: : Probably both. It’s fun being able to test how smooth I am on someone who isn’t going to cave.
lines.zh: : 大概两者都是。在一个绝不会屈服的人身上测试我有多油嘴滑舌,挺有趣的。

lines.en: : Wow. I’m starting to think you might be more in-need of new interests than me and your relationship isn’t teetering on the edge of destruction right now.
lines.zh: : 哇。我开始觉得,比我更需要新爱好的人可能是你——毕竟你的感情现在并没有在毁灭边缘摇摇欲坠。

lines.en: : If you’re looking for a new hobby, how about fishing?
lines.zh: : 如果你在找新爱好,钓鱼怎么样?

lines.en: scene osakonewhair26
: Fishing?
lines.zh: : 钓鱼?

lines.en: : This again?
lines.zh: : 又来这套?

lines.en: : It’s what my husband used to do when he was looking to clear his head. And based on that “teetering on the edge of destruction” comment, it sounds like that might help.
lines.zh: : 我老公以前想清空脑袋的时候,就会去干这个。根据你那句「在毁灭边缘摇摇欲坠」,听起来这兴许能帮上忙。

lines.en: : Porn is great and all. Like, don’t get me wrong — it’s my favorite thing in the world. But I can see how it wouldn’t be...beneficial during times like this.
lines.zh: : 色情片固然很棒。别误会——它是我在世界上最爱的事物。但我看得出来,在这种时期,它可能不算……有益。

lines.en: : Even if I don’t really grasp what the specific issue is.
lines.zh: : 尽管我并没有真正搞清具体问题是什么。

lines.en: : Osako’s trying to be more confident and independent so her entire existence stops revolving around her significant other.
lines.zh: : Osako 正在努力变得更自信、更独立,好让她整个存在的运转,不再围绕她的另一半。

lines.en: : Oh. Well, maybe fishing’s not the best bet then. Maybe you should become a race car driver.
lines.zh: : 哦。那钓鱼也许不是最好的选择。也许你该去当赛车手。

lines.en: scene osakonewhair27
: You two are pretty terrible at this, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 你们俩在这件事上可真够烂的,不是吗?

lines.en: : Hey, we’re not the ones who can’t figure out what to do with our lives.
lines.zh: : 嘿,搞不清自己的人生该干嘛的人,可不是我们。

lines.en: : You’re absolutely someone who can’t figure out what to do with his life.
lines.zh: : 你绝对就是那种搞不清自己的人生该干嘛的人。

lines.en: : Okay, yeah. But Maki’s not. She was born to sell sex to people. And we were born to buy it.
lines.zh: : 好,是。但 Maki 不是。她生来就是向人贩卖性的。而我们生来就是购买的。

lines.en: : Can you please stop lumping me in with you just because I followed you to a porn shop I was probably going to come to this week anyway?
lines.zh: : 能不能别因为我跟你来了一趟情趣用品店——反正这周我大概也会来——就把我和你归为一类?

lines.en: : I can, yeah. But I want you to know that this is how I’m trying to connect with you because I do want you to become more confident in yourself.
lines.zh: : 可以,当然。但我想让你知道,我是在用这种方式尝试和你建立联结,因为我真心想让你变得更自信。

lines.en: : You’re too...strong and loyal to be all miserable like this. And I want your relationship to succeed just as badly as you do.
lines.zh: : 你这么……强壮、这么忠诚,不该惨成这副样子。我像你一样,迫切希望你们的感情能成功。

lines.en: : Yeah, but you only want it to succeed because you think it increases your chances of having a threesome with us one day and that is very much not the case.
lines.zh: : 是啊,但你希望它成功,只是因为你觉得这会增加某天和我们来一场三人行的概率——而那绝无可能。

lines.en: : That’s not true, Osako. Seriously.
lines.zh: : 不是那样的,Osako。说真的。

lines.en: scene osakonewhair28
: So you’d reject such an invitation if it ever actually happened?
lines.zh: : 所以,这种邀请要是真发生了,你会拒绝?

lines.en: : I mean...no. But it’s not like I have an ulterior motive here.
lines.zh: : 就是说……不会。但这不代表我有什么别有用心的动机。

lines.en: : I want you to get better because I want you to be happy. And I just think it would be cool if you two could go back to being happy together rather than confused and...distant.
lines.zh: : 我希望你变好,是因为我想让你幸福。我只是觉得,如果你们俩能回到幸福的往日,而不是困惑且……疏远,那会很酷。

lines.en: scene osakonewhair29
: You...do?
lines.zh: : 你……真的这么想?

lines.en: : Obviously, yes. I’ve been trying to tell you that this whole time.
lines.zh: : 废话,是的。我从一开始就在试着告诉你这个。

lines.en: : Sorry, I just...don’t really get why you’re being so nice to me when Wakana’s the one you’re close with. You and I are kinda just, like...there.
lines.zh: : 抱歉,我只是……不太明白,你亲近的人明明是 Wakana,为什么对我这么好。你我之间,大概只是……存在而已。

lines.en: : Yeah, but we don’t have to be. We can be closer. I want to be closer.
lines.zh: : 是啊,但我们不必止步于此。我们可以更亲近。我想更亲近。

lines.en: scene osakonewhair30
: Is this about the haircut again? Because you never got like this with me until-
lines.zh: : 这又是发型引起的吗?因为在那之前,你从来没对我这样过——

lines.en: : No. It’s about me being in the same boat as you. Just instead of it being a relationship that’s teetering on the edge, it’s everything about me.
lines.zh: : 不。是因为我和你在同一条船上。只不过摇摇欲坠的不是一段感情,而是我的一切。

lines.en: scene osakonewhair31
: I’m not happy. And I want to change too. So being around someone who also wants to do that is...
lines.zh: : 我并不幸福。我也想改变。所以待在一个同样想改变的人身边,是……

lines.en: scene osakonewhair32
: Wait, where did Maki go?
lines.zh: : 等等,Maki 去哪了?

lines.en: : Refilling the lotions! It seemed like you two were about to have a moment and I didn’t want to get in the way!
lines.zh: : 去补充润滑液了!看你们俩正要来一段真情时刻,我可不想碍事!

lines.en: : Well, that’s...nice.
lines.zh: : 这还真是……贴心。

lines.en: : Akira, I...
lines.zh: : Akira,我……

lines.en: : I don’t really know what to say. I’ve never really thought of you on...that level before.
lines.zh: : 我真的不知道该说什么。我从没在……那个层面上想过你。

lines.en: scene osakonewhair33
: And I’m not saying you should now. I get that we’re not close, and that it’s hard to just...open up to people you’re not really comfortable with.
lines.zh: : 我也不是说你现在就该。我明白我们并不亲近,也明白对自己并不真正自在的人敞开心扉有多难。

lines.en: : But I know you care about me on some level because of what you said in the diner. And I’m the type of person who can’t help but immediately latch onto any amount of affection from anyone.
lines.zh: : 但我知道,某种程度上你是在乎我的——你在餐馆里说过的话证明了这点。而我这种人,只要收到任何人一丝一毫的温情,都忍不住立刻抓住不放。

lines.en: scene osakonewhair34
: And how you kicked the living shit out of me just before we went there.
lines.zh: : 还有我们在那之前,你把我揍得半死的那次。

lines.en: : I obviously can’t do that to you, so...I guess this is my equivalent.
lines.zh: : 显然我没法对你来那个,所以……我猜这就是我的等价交换。

lines.en: : But I’m clearly not good at connecting with people verbally, so...
lines.zh: : 但显然,我不擅长用言语和人建立联结,所以……

lines.en: : No, dude...I appreciate it.
lines.zh: : 不,伙计……我很感激。

lines.en: : You’re just so fucking...odd that I can’t normally figure out when and...if you’re being serious.
lines.zh: : 你这家伙实在他妈的……古怪,以至于我平时根本分不清你什么时候、……是否在当真。

lines.en: : You’d think that after dealing with Wakana for so long that I’d be able to get a grasp of that easier, but...I guess it’s a little harder when you don’t also want to screw the person in question.
lines.zh: : 你会觉得,和 Wakana 打了那么久交道之后,我该更容易摸透这种事,但……我猜,当你并不顺便想上那个当事人的话,就要难上一点。

lines.en: : That’s fair. I’d probably feel the same way in your position.
lines.zh: : 有道理。换作你的位置,我大概也一样。

lines.en: : You really want to be closer to me?
lines.zh: : 你真的想和我更亲近?

lines.en: scene osakonewhair35
: If you’re okay with that, yeah.
lines.zh: : 只要你不介意,是的。

lines.en: : And you’re fine with me not wanting to screw you?
lines.zh: : 还有,我不想和你上床,你也没意见?

lines.en: : I am, yeah.
lines.zh: : 没意见,是的。

lines.en: : And you’re not going to try and screw my girlfriend?
lines.zh: : 还有,你也不会试图去上我的女朋友?

lines.en: : Do you want to just make a checklist for me to go over when I get home later? Because it seems like that might be best right now.
lines.zh: : 要不你干脆列张清单,等我晚点回家再逐条核对?因为眼下,那似乎是最佳方案。

lines.en: scene osakonewhair36
: No...it’s fine.
lines.zh: : 不……没事。

lines.en: : Let’s...hang out more. Maybe we can find something to do together that...isn’t sitting around and watching porn.
lines.zh: : 我们……多出去聚聚吧。也许我们能找到点可以一起做的事……而不是坐着看色情片。

lines.en: : Are you sure it can’t be that? Because the MILF of the Month club does sound really fun.
lines.zh: : 你确定不能是那个吗?因为本月 MILF 俱乐部听起来真的很好玩。

lines.en: scene osakonewhair37
: You know, that Kobayakawa girl really is hot. So if they’re all like this and it’s only once a month...
lines.zh: : 你说,那个 Kobayakawa 女士是真辣。所以如果她们都这水准,而且一个月才一次……

lines.en: : You think you’d ever hook up with a girl that age?
lines.zh: : 你觉得你会和那个年纪的女人搭上吗?

lines.en: : I don’t know. I’ve only been with Wakana before. But, like...isn’t that girl even younger than Rika?
lines.zh: : 我不知道。我之前只和 Wakana 在一起过。可是……那不是比 Rika 还年轻吗?

lines.en: : You think you’d ever hook up with Rika?
lines.zh: : 你觉得你会和 Rika 搭上吗?

lines.en: : She has a better shot than you do, at least.
lines.zh: : 至少她的胜算比你大。

lines.en: scene black
: I want to be offended by that, but Rika’s extremely attractive and I understand completely.
lines.zh: : 我想为这话生气,但 Rika 确实魅力惊人,我完全理解。

lines.en: : I’m gonna tell her you said that the next time we’re at the bar.
lines.zh: : 下次去酒吧,我要把这话原样告诉她。

lines.en: : You don’t have to. I’ll do it myself. Just not while Imani’s around. She gets jealous easily.
lines.zh: : 不用你告诉。我自己会讲。只是别挑 Imani 在场的时候。她很容易吃醋。

lines.en: : True. You two have sex yet?
lines.zh: : 倒也是。你们俩做过吗?

lines.en: : Nah, we’re waiting until the next time all four of us are together.
lines.zh: : 没有,我们打算等下次我们四个凑齐的时候。

lines.en: : Okay. But if you make eye contact with me again while that’s happening, I swear to God that we’re never hanging out again.
lines.zh: : 行。但如果那种事进行的时候,你敢再和我对视,我对天发誓,我们再也不会一起出来玩了。

lines.en: : I just wanted to make sure you were doing everything correctly.
lines.zh: : 我只是想确认你每个步骤都做得正确。

lines.en: : Hey, remember earlier when I said I fucking hate you?
lines.zh: : 嘿,还记得我刚才说我他妈恨你吗?

lines.en: Maki comes back into the room a few minutes later and the three of us finish watching the MILF of the Month have sex with...many different men.
lines.zh: 几分钟后 Maki 回到房间,我们三个看完了本月 MILF 和……许多不同男人的性爱。

lines.en: And despite that “film” dragging on for way longer than it had any right to, I think it’s safe to say we all had a good time.
lines.zh: 尽管那部「影片」的时长,远远超过了它应有的分寸,但我敢说,我们都度过了愉快的时光。

lines.en: And I think it’s safe to say that I’m on the cusp of having another close friend.
lines.zh: 我也敢说,我正处在拥有又一位挚友的边缘。

lines.en: So maybe Osako can be what I wanted Imani to be — someone I can spend time with and just...
lines.zh: 所以,也许 Osako 能成为我想让 Imani 成为的那种人——一个我可以与之共度时光、然后只是……

lines.en: That’s it.
lines.zh: 就是这样。

lines.en: That’s all I need sometimes.
lines.zh: 有时候,我需要的仅此而已。

lines.en: We go our separate ways.
lines.zh: 我们各自踏上归途。

lines.en: But she falls asleep holding someone who sees her, and I fall asleep holding myself.
lines.zh: 但她抱着一个看得见她的人入睡,而我抱着我自己入睡。
